known.via: English Wikipedia "Drăgăşani" (redirects to "Drăgășani") (a wine place on Wikidata)

climate.koppen_name: Cold, no dry season, hot summer

blurb.text: A Romanian PDO named for a city in Vâlcea County, on the Olt river, whose neighboring hills are well known for Wallachian wines. Its rules allow Negru de Drăgăşani, Novac, Cabernet Sauvignon, Merlot, Fetească Regală and Tămâioasă Românească.
